text:
elaine: quick alignment check — launching the batching+cache runtime changes. Goal: reduce median latency for hosted text-gen by ~20% and P95 by ~30%, keep token unit cost within +5% of baseline. Proposed canary: 2026-04-15, full roll: 2026-04-29. Need blockers, owners, and gating criteria.
sam: narrowing scope: don't change embeddings routing in this train — postpone to next milestone. focus on prefix KV caching + kernel selection. Product will own customer comms and rollback policy.
jordan: runtime update: kernel selector merged but failing a KV eviction case on long sequences. perf harness shows 18% median improvement on short seqs, tail still noisy. ETA for fix: ~10 business days.
marta: infra can stand up a dedicated canary pool (4 GPU nodes) but need cost sign-off; also need an autoscaler tweak so batch_size target holds steady under burst traffic.
raj: security note: hosted path is fine; for Private deploys we need to run KMS rotation + HSM key access tests — that's a gating item for Private customers only, not hosted. also want an SCA review of the new binary.
ops-bot: ci/canary-tests report: 12/20 perf tests passing. Failing ones point to memory growth in kv_evict branch. Full logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/1234
sam: scope negotiation: agreed to drop embeddings change. Product will draft release notes and customer-impact matrix. Need rollout playbook with explicit rollback triggers (P95 > baseline, error rate > 0.5%, or heap growth > 10% over 30m).
elaine: owners: runtime=jordan, infra=marta, security=raj, product=sam. Dependencies: infra ticket for pool + autoscaler, runtime PR with e2e perf, security SCA and KMS test plan, cs comms doc. Also request 1x contractor (SRE-focused) for 4 weeks to stabilize canary tests.
jordan: I’ll open the e2e PR today with perf harness output. will flag memory leak fix as high priority.
marta: creating infra ticket now (INC-4521) and asking finance for temporary budget. pinging @ops-team for quota.
raj: I'll scope KMS rotation tests and post the checklist here by EOD.
sam: here's a minimal rollout checklist:
```
1) infra canary pool provisioned (4x gpus)
2) runtime e2e perf >= target on canary
3) security KMS + SCA signoff (Private only gating)
4) canary run 48h under traffic replay
5) staged traffic ramp 10% -> 50% -> 100% with rollback gates
6) rollback automation and postmortem owner assigned
```

sam: also: if canary fails due to tail latency regressions, fallback to prior kernel selector and disable kv caching incrementally.
elaine: asks: can each owner confirm by tomorrow EOD? if we get green, I’ll lock launch dates and ask CS for targeted outreach to top 5 enterprise tenants.
sam: ack from product.
jordan: working on fix, expect e2e PR in next 24h.
marta: infra ticket done and cost ask filed.
raj: will post KMS checklist tonight.
ops-bot: auto-note: perf-tests scheduled for nightly run; will post results in this thread.
elaine: thanks — will recheck on tomorrow sync. :thumbsup:
